# Deployment Checklist for Upcoming Release

## Pre-Deployment (48 hours before)

- [ ] Verify all code changes are merged to release branch
- [ ] Run full test suite and confirm passing
- [ ] Update version numbers in all relevant files
- [ ] Generate and review release notes
- [ ] Backup production database
- [ ] Verify staging environment mirrors production
- [ ] Conduct final QA testing on staging
- [ ] Schedule deployment window with all stakeholders
- [ ] Prepare rollback plan and procedures

## Communication

- [ ] Notify all team members of deployment time
- [ ] Alert customer support of scheduled maintenance window
- [ ] Prepare status page update (if applicable)
- [ ] Brief on-call engineer on deployment details

## Immediate Pre-Deployment (30 minutes before)

- [ ] Verify all team members are available
- [ ] Confirm deployment credentials are accessible
- [ ] Do final check of deployment scripts
- [ ] Ensure monitoring/alerting is active
- [ ] Disable automated deployments if applicable

## Deployment Execution

- [ ] Deploy to staging (if not already done)
- [ ] Run smoke tests on staging
- [ ] Deploy to production (canary/blue-green if applicable)
- [ ] Monitor error rates and performance metrics
- [ ] Verify all critical features functioning
- [ ] Check database migrations completed successfully

## Post-Deployment (1 hour after)

- [ ] Confirm all services are healthy
- [ ] Run production smoke tests
- [ ] Monitor logs for errors or warnings
- [ ] Check performance metrics
- [ ] Verify customer-facing features work
- [ ] Document any issues encountered

## Follow-up (24 hours after)

- [ ] Collect feedback from stakeholders
- [ ] Run comprehensive test suite
- [ ] Conduct retrospective if issues occurred
- [ ] Archive deployment logs
- [ ] Update documentation if needed
